title: reprodICU Derived Static Schema
description: A single per-stay value computed from other columns of a reprodICU table. No variable upstream has this shape today; the type exists because the derivation rule is a cross product and a definition that combines `calculation` with `dynamic: false` must have somewhere valid to land. Upstream's vars.json carries no `type` key, so the importer derives one from the entry's shape: `calculation` present -> derived_*, absent -> native_*; `dynamic: false` -> *_static, `dynamic` absent or true -> *_dynamic. The four reprodicu schemas encode that same rule, so a definition can only ever validate against the type it would be assigned.

path.description: The reprodICU table the inputs of `calculation` are read from

column.description: Name the computed column is materialised under, and the one `filter` addresses

is_struct.description: Whether the computed column is a polars struct rather than a plain value; the filter then addresses its fields with `.struct.field(...)`

filter.description: Polars predicate selecting this variable's rows, as an expression over `pl`

calculation.description: Polars expression computing `column` from other columns of `path`. Its presence is what makes the variable derived rather than native

dynamic.description: What makes this variable static: one value per stay rather than a time series

unit.description: Unit of the computed value, folded in from the source's units.json at import. Absent for dimensionless variables (scores, flags, categories)
